scope: M1 process-owned native configuration backup query, bounded rotation, explicit restore and digest-confirmed cleanup. Software product outlet; full Moonraker, actual backup management UI and physical acceptance remain pending.

upstream.note: These printer.host.config routes are controlled native additions, not proof that the full upstream file-manager contract is closed.

implementation.rotation: Create and fsync exact old bytes, fsync replacement and parent, then remove the oldest managed backup and sync the directory. Unknown prefix entries count toward capacity and are never automatically deleted.
implementation.managed: UUID v4 naming in the source directory; regular file, single hardlink, exact 0600 mode and current service uid. List metadata is observational; mutation revalidates.
implementation.restore: Current-source SHA-256 and selected-backup SHA-256 required; bounded immutable snapshot; hold the current writer gate through download/upload authorization and transaction settlement; save current version; applied=false and restartRequired=true. No implicit printer operation.
implementation.delete: Same writer lock and gate as save; selected digest must match; keep at least one managed recovery copy; post-unlink sync failure returns phase=removed uncertainty.
implementation.lifecycle: Track at most four backup metadata authorizations; close waits for actual ignored cancellation settlement. Restore/delete reuse the existing generation, printer-idle, confirmed-stop and host-transition writer fences.
